name: rootloom
description: Four focused OpenAI Codex Skills for inspectable change, review, project guidance, and setup.

interface.shortDescription: Scoped engineering with bounded artifact context.
interface.longDescription: Rootloom provides four local Skills for Change, Review, Project Guidance, and Setup. Complete authorized work with proportional checks; use cached artifact receipts when repeated reads justify them. Governed and Evidence procedures load only when applicable. Project Memory is a separate optional plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use Change to complete this task with proportional verification; use bounded artifact reads and receipt reuse when useful.
Review this change and separate findings from suggested or executed verification.
Seed, refine, or validate concise evidence-backed AGENTS.md guidance.
